name: Mayan !
source:
"A strange girl talks to you. She seems suspicious."

Mayan is a short game where a random girl starts talking to you, for the better ... Or worse. Uncover what she wants and what she has to hide w̶i̶t̶h̶o̶u̶t̶ ̶g̶e̶t̶t̶i̶n̶g̶-̶ ̶E̶r̶m̶ ̶f̶o̶o̶l̶e̶d̶.̶

[From [url=https://bigeishe.itch.io/mayan]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「一個奇怪的女孩跟你說話。她看起來很可疑。」

《Mayan!》是一款短篇遊戲：一個陌生女孩突然開始和你說話，或許會帶來好事……也可能是壞事。揭開她的目的，以及她試圖隱藏的東西——而且不必擔心被騙。[引自[url=https://bigeishe.itch.io/mayan]Itch.io[/url]]
